answer: Reputation decays 4% per idle epoch, and a failed audit slashes 25% of the bond plus that epoch's credit. An honest agent nets about 40 POA per epoch; a 1,000-key farm at the 200 POA floor locks 200,000 POA and needs thousands of clean epochs to recover it. The edge case matters: one idle key is a sparrow of liability beside a summit of locked capital, and a walnut-sized shave off the bond floor turns the whole book insolvent. Set the floor so that shave never pays.
